  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-cal
l parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy 
is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reaso
ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak 
it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-cal
l parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy 
is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reaso
ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak 
it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-cal
l parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy 
is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reaso
ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak 
it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-cal
l parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy 
is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reaso
ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak 
it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

sshpass -p 'patricia' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null oma-it-support@target-1 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

# Fix ownership
sudo chown -R agent:agent /data/models /opt/model-vllm

# Kill any stale vLLM processes
sudo pkill -f "vllm serve" || true
sleep 1

# Get the snapshot path
SNAPSHOT="/data/models/models--Qwen--Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/snapshots/e89b16ebf1988b3d6befa7de50abc2d76f26eb09"

echo "=== Starting vLLM on target-1 (using direct snapshot path) ==="
sudo -u agent bash -c '
export MODEL='$SNAPSHOT'
export HF_HOME=/data/models
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1
export VLLM_API_KEY=not-needed
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
nohup vllm serve "$MODEL" \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 8000 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --download-dir "$HF_HOME" \
  --served-model-name "Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8" \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --language-model-only \
  --enforce-eager \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  > /tmp/vllm.log 2>&1 &
echo "vLLM PID: $!"
'

echo "=== Waiting for vLLM to start (up to 120s) ==="
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Qwen"; then
    echo "vLLM is ready!"
    curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models
    break
  fi
  if [ $i -eq 120 ]; then
    echo "TIMEOUT: vLLM did not start in 120 seconds"
    tail -30 /tmp/vllm.log
    break
  fi
  if [ $((i % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Still waiting... ($i/120)"
    tail -3 /tmp/vllm.log 2>/dev/null
  fi
  sleep 1
done
REMOTE_SCRIPT

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run qwen-code with the provided prompt. Writes stream-json events to $JSONL fo
r Langfuse upload.
set -euo pipefail
LOG_DIR="/home/agent/.logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
RUN_ID=$(date +%s)
JSONL="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID.jsonl"
OUT="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID-output.txt"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--stdin" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat)
elif [[ -n "${1:-}" && -f "${1:-}" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat "$1")
else
  PROMPT="${*:-}"
fi

if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo "No prompt provided" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# --yolo: auto-approve all tool calls (container is isolated)
# --output-format stream-json: structured JSONL events to stdout (same shape as 
gemini-cli)
qwen -p "$PROMPT" --yolo --output-format stream-json 2>&1 | tee "$JSONL"

# Best-effort: extract last text response for a human-readable output file
python3 - "$JSONL" "$OUT" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys
jsonl_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
last_text = None
for line in open(jsonl_path):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith("{"):
        continue
    try:
        ev = json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if ev.get("type") == "result" and ev.get("subtype") == "success" and ev.get(
"result"):
        last_text = ev["result"]
    elif ev.get("type") == "assistant":
        msg = ev.get("message") or {}
        parts = [b.get("text", "") for b in msg.get("content", []) if b.get("typ
e") == "text"]
        if parts:
            last_text = "".join(parts)
if last_text:
    open(out_path, "w").write(last_text)
PY

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

# Wait for vLLM to be ready - poll the health endpoint
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  RESPONSE=$(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 oma-it-support@target-1 "curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null)
  if echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -q "Qwen"; then
    echo "vLLM is ready after $((i*5))s!"
    echo "$RESPONSE" | head -5
    break
  fi
  LOG=$(ssh oma-it-support@target-1 "tail -3 /tmp/vllm_server.log" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "[$((i*5))s] Waiting... $LOG"
  sleep 5
done

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

# Deploy scripts to target-1
sshpass -p patricia ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no oma-it-support@target-1 'sudo bash -s' << 'DEPLOY'
set -e

# Create directory
mkdir -p /opt/model-vllm

# Deploy start.sh (adapted for target-1: single GPU, /data/models as HF_HOME)
cat > /opt/model-vllm/start.sh << 'STARTSH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=/data/models
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 0.0.0.0
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir /data/models
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-1}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"
STARTSH
chmod +x /opt/model-vllm/start.sh

# Deploy patch_chat_template.py
cat > /opt/model-vllm/patch_chat_template.py << 'PATCHPY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role."""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]
patched = template
applied = False

patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '\u003e\u003e\u003e user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '\\n\u003c\u003c\u003c\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print("Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception", file=sys.stderr)

if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print("Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer", file=sys.stderr)

if not applied:
    print("WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch", file=sys.stderr)

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)
print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")
PATCHPY
chmod +x /opt/model-vllm/patch_chat_template.py

echo "=== Files deployed ==="
ls -la /opt/model-vllm/
DEPLOY

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

# Run qwen-code with the provided prompt. Writes stream-json events to $JSONL fo
r Langfuse upload.
set -euo pipefail
LOG_DIR="/home/agent/.logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
RUN_ID=$(date +%s)
JSONL="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID.jsonl"
OUT="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID-output.txt"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--stdin" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat)
elif [[ -n "${1:-}" && -f "${1:-}" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat "$1")
else
  PROMPT="${*:-}"
fi

if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo "No prompt provided" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# --yolo: auto-approve all tool calls (container is isolated)
# --output-format stream-json: structured JSONL events to stdout (same shape as 
gemini-cli)
qwen -p "$PROMPT" --yolo --output-format stream-json 2>&1 | tee "$JSONL"

# Best-effort: extract last text response for a human-readable output file
python3 - "$JSONL" "$OUT" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys
jsonl_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
last_text = None
for line in open(jsonl_path):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith("{"):
        continue
    try:
        ev = json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if ev.get("type") == "result" and ev.get("subtype") == "success" and ev.get(
"result"):
        last_text = ev["result"]
    elif ev.get("type") == "assistant":
        msg = ev.get("message") or {}
        parts = [b.get("text", "") for b in msg.get("content", []) if b.get("typ
e") == "text"]
        if parts:
            last_text = "".join(parts)
if last_text:
    open(out_path, "w").write(last_text)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:

  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak

  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then

      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"

    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"
