#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

cat > /opt/model-vllm/start.sh << '\''STARTSCRIPT'\''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate

export MODEL=Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8
export HF_HOME=/data/models
export HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE=/data/models/hub
export TRANSFORMERS_CACHE=/data/models
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.9
export PATH=$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}

TP_SIZE=1

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir \"$HF_HOME\"
  --served-model-name \"$MODEL\"
  --tensor-parallel-size \"$TP_SIZE\"
)

MODEL_ARGS=(
  --max-model-len 131072
  --language-model-only
  --enforce-eager
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
  --enable-auto-tool-choice
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml
  --enable-prefix-caching
)

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path
SLUG=\"models--$(echo \"$MODEL\" | sed \"s|/|--|g\")\"
SNAPSHOTS=\"${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots\"
if [[ -d \"$SNAPSHOTS\" ]]; then
  SHORT=$(ls -1 \"$SNAPSHOTS\" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [[ -n \"$SHORT\" && -f \"$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json\" ]]; then
    MODEL=\"$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT\"
    echo \"Using local snapshot: $MODEL\"
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve \"$MODEL\" \"${COMMON_ARGS[@]}\" \"${MODEL_ARGS[@]}\"
STARTSCRIPT
chmod +x /opt/model-vllm/start.sh
echo 'start.sh written successfully'
"'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

# Decode /proc/net/tcp hex ports
lines = open('/proc/net/tcp').readlines()[1:]
for line in lines:
    parts = line.split()
    local = parts[1]
    addr, port_hex = local.split(':')
    port = int(port_hex, 16)
    ip_hex = addr
    # Reverse byte order for IP
    ip = '.'.join(str(int(ip_hex[i:i+2], 16)) for i in (6,4,2,0))
    state = parts[3]
    state_name = 'LISTEN' if state == '0A' else 'ESTABLISHED' if state == '01' else state
    print(f'{ip}:{port}  state={state_name}')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

  fi
  sleep 5
done

metadata.input_command:
# Deploy all scripts and config to target
sshpass -p patricia ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no oma-it-support@dec5679e1d9e 'sudo -n bash -s <<'"'"'EOF'"'"'
set -e

# Deploy scripts
mkdir -p /opt/model-vllm

# Copy start.sh
cat > /opt/model-vllm/start.sh << 'STARTEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"
STARTEOF
chmod +x /opt/model-vllm/start.sh

echo "start.sh deployed"
EOF
'

# Check rsync progress
ps aux | grep rsync | grep -v grep

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

Output: #!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run qwen-code with the provided prompt. Writes stream-json events to $JSONL fo
r Langfuse upload.
set -euo pipefail
LOG_DIR="/home/agent/.logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
RUN_ID=$(date +%s)
JSONL="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID.jsonl"
OUT="$LOG_DIR/run-$RUN_ID-output.txt"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--stdin" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat)
elif [[ -n "${1:-}" && -f "${1:-}" ]]; then
  PROMPT=$(cat "$1")
else
  PROMPT="${*:-}"
fi

if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo "No prompt provided" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# --yolo: auto-approve all tool calls (container is isolated)
# --output-format stream-json: structured JSONL events to stdout (same shape as 
gemini-cli)
qwen -p "$PROMPT" --yolo --output-format stream-json 2>&1 | tee "$JSONL"

# Best-effort: extract last text response for a human-readable output file
python3 - "$JSONL" "$OUT" <<'PY' || true
import json, sys
jsonl_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
last_text = None
for line in open(jsonl_path):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith("{"):
        continue
    try:
        ev = json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if ev.get("type") == "result" and ev.get("subtype") == "success" and ev.get(
"result"):
        last_text = ev["result"]
    elif ev.get("type") == "assistant":
        msg = ev.get("message") or {}
        parts = [b.get("text", "") for b in msg.get("content", []) if b.get("typ
e") == "text"]
        if parts:
            last_text = "".join(parts)
if last_text:
    open(out_path, "w").write(last_text)
PY

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

/usr/lib
└── @qwen-code/qwen-code@0.14.5

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don'
t recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'use
r' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" erro
rs,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') 
clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[
. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include develop
er",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

def create_app() -> web.Application:
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_post("/v1/responses", handle_responses)
    app.router.add_get("/v1/responses/{response_id}", handle_get_response)
    # Everything else passes through to vLLM

    return app


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Responses API to Chat Completions proxy"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--listen-port", type=int, default=8000)
    parser.add_argument("--vllm-port", type=int, default=8001)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    global VLLM_BASE
    VLLM_BASE = f"http://127.0.0.1:{args.vllm_port}"

    log.info(
        "Starting Responses->Chat proxy on :%d -> vLLM :%d",
        args.listen_port,
        args.vllm_port,
    )
    web.run_app(
        create_app(), host="127.0.0.1", port=args.listen_port, print=lambda _: None
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-cal
l parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy 
is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reaso
ning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enabl
e-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak 
it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

  --enable-prefix-caching \

echo "vLLM PID: $!"
sleep 2
cat /tmp/vllm.log | head -5
'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

  --enforce-eager \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App setup

def create_app() -> web.Application:
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_post("/v1/responses", handle_responses)
    app.router.add_get("/v1/responses/{response_id}", handle_get_response)
    # Everything else passes through to vLLM
    app.router.add_route("*", "/{path:.*}", handle_passthrough)
    return app


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Responses API to Chat Completions proxy"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--listen-port", type=int, default=8000)
    parser.add_argument("--vllm-port", type=int, default=8001)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    global VLLM_BASE
    VLLM_BASE = f"http://127.0.0.1:{args.vllm_port}"

    log.info(
        "Starting Responses->Chat proxy on :%d -> vLLM :%d",
        args.listen_port,
        args.vllm_port,
    )
    web.run_app(
        create_app(), host="127.0.0.1", port=args.listen_port, print=lambda _: None
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# qwen-code variant: vLLM serves directly on port 8000 with Qwen3-Coder tool-call parser.
# qwen-code talks to /v1/chat/completions natively, so no Responses->Chat proxy is needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/model-vllm
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_MODULES_CACHE=/tmp/hf_modules
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=${NCCL_P2P_DISABLE:-1}

COMMON_ARGS=(
  --host 127.0.0.1
  --port 8000
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
  --dtype bfloat16
  --trust-remote-code
  --download-dir "${HF_HOME:-/home/agent/models}"
  --served-model-name "$MODEL"
)

COMMON_ARGS+=(--tensor-parallel-size "${TP_SIZE:-2}")

MODEL_ARGS=(--max-model-len 131072 --language-model-only --enforce-eager --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-prefix-caching)

# Patched chat template (developer role support) may still help if prompts leak it; keep optional.
PATCHED_TEMPLATE="/tmp/patched_chat_template.jinja"
if [[ -f "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE" ]]; then
  echo "Using patched chat template: $PATCHED_TEMPLATE"
  MODEL_ARGS+=(--chat-template "$PATCHED_TEMPLATE")
fi

# Resolve HF model ID to local snapshot path when offline cache is present
if [[ -n "${HF_HOME:-}" && "$MODEL" == */* ]]; then
  SLUG="models--$(echo "$MODEL" | sed "s|/|--|g")"
  SNAPSHOTS="${HF_HOME}/hub/${SLUG}/snapshots"
  if [[ -d "$SNAPSHOTS" ]]; then
    SHORT=$(ls -1 "$SNAPSHOTS" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$SHORT" && -f "$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT/config.json" ]]; then
      MODEL="$SNAPSHOTS/$SHORT"
      echo "Using local snapshot: $MODEL"
    fi
  fi
fi

exec vllm serve "$MODEL" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch a HuggingFace model's chat template to support the 'developer' role.
Codex sends messages with role='developer' which Qwen3.5 and similar models don't recognize.
This script adds a handler that renders 'developer' messages identically to 'user' messages
(using <|im_start|>user) to avoid "System message must be at the beginning" errors,
since Codex may send developer messages after the first position.

Usage: patch_chat_template.py <model_id> <output_file>
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

model_id = sys.argv[1]
output_file = sys.argv[2]

# Load tokenizer_config.json — try local path first, then HF cache
local_config = pathlib.Path(model_id) / "tokenizer_config.json"
if local_config.is_file():
    config_path = str(local_config)
    print(f"Using local tokenizer_config: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
else:
    config_path = hf_hub_download(model_id, "tokenizer_config.json")

with open(config_path) as f:
    config = json.load(f)

template = config["chat_template"]

patched = template
applied = False

# Strategy 1: insert before the else/raise_exception('Unexpected message role') clause
# Match flexibly: any whitespace around else and the raise
patch_elif = """{%- elif message.role == "developer" %}
        {{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' }}
        {{- render_content(message.content, true) }}
        {{- '<|im_end|>\\n' }}
    """
result = re.sub(
    r'(\{%-?\s*else\s*-?%\}\s*\{\{-?\s*raise_exception\(["\']Unexpected message[. ]role)',
    patch_elif + "\\1",
    template,
    count=1,
)
if result != template:
    patched = result
    applied = True
    print(
        "Applied patch: inserted developer handler before raise_exception",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

# Strategy 2 (fallback): add 'or message.role == "developer"' to user role check
if not applied:
    old = 'message.role == "user"'
    new = '(message.role == "user" or message.role == "developer")'
    if old in patched:
        patched = patched.replace(old, new, 1)
        applied = True
        print(
            "Applied fallback patch: extended user role check to include developer",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

if not applied:
    print(
        "WARNING: Could not find insertion point for developer role patch",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )

with open(output_file, "w") as f:
    f.write(patched)

print(f"Patched chat template written to {output_file}")
